text:
nina: Hey team, found a funky pattern in the onboarding quickstart under mixed load: paginators freeze for ~2s then a burst of requests. Repro: ./scripts/loadgen --clients=42 --pages=9 --mix search:heavy,embed:heavy.

raf: Which SDK/sampleapp combo? Any logs?

nina: js-sdk@0.12.7 + quickstart@main. Tail excerpt:
```
WARN governor: queued (scope=global) inflight=195
DEBUG paginator: holding cursor waiting for permit page=6
INFO auth: refresh kicked off by worker-9
INFO retry: immediate_requeue=true bypassing-governor
ERROR api: 403 transient_token
```

cheng: "bypassing-governor" stands out. We intentionally fast-path some retry paths but that seems to synchronize retries after a slow refresh and produces a burst.

tess: The sampleapp allocates one SDK client per process so the global governor ends up shared across routes. If embed calls are heavier, they steal permits and paginators queue up holding cursors. Head-of-line blocking.

nina: Short-term mitigation we used in demos: run sampleapp with MULTI_CLIENT_PER_ROUTE=true to avoid cross-route permit stealing. Not ideal for users though.

raf: Proposed fix list: 1) make governor.scope configurable (global|client|route) with default global for compat; 2) ensure retry and auth refresh paths go through governor.acquire() (no bypass); 3) add SDK-level singleflight for token refresh; 4) change paginator to prefetch next page token asynchronously so it doesn't hold the cursor while waiting.

cheng: For singleflight: implement as Map<string,Promise>. On refresh start insert promise; other callers await it; on resolution remove key. Add a small safety TTL slightly less than token TTL so we don't refresh too aggressively. Unit tests: simulate 12 concurrent callers and assert only 1 external refresh call.

tess: Also add a tiny randomized backoff after refresh success before retrying callers (e.g., 10-50ms jitter) to avoid synchronized flushes. And emit telemetry: governor.scope and auth.refresh.concurrent_count and paginator.hold_ms.

nina: I sketched a sampleapp patch: add PREFETCH_NEXT=true toggle, MULTI_CLIENT_PER_ROUTE flag, and a load-test harness. Will open a draft PR.

raf: Implementation notes for governor.scope: keep default global for backwards compat. When scope=route, key governor by route path and method; scope=client keys by client instance id. Ensure leases are cheap and tests cover cross-route fairness.

cheng: Where should singleflight live? SDK auth core so every client benefits. We'll need to be careful with apps that implement token rotation themselves; document the change.

tess: CI: add e2e in devex/load-e2e that runs mixed traffic for 90s and asserts no stall >3s and p95 < 600ms and no auth 5xx spikes. Also unit tests for retry path to ensure it never sets immediate_requeue/bypass flags.

ci-bot: Please file issue area/devex and tag test/e2e + priority/medium. Link PRs and add canary rollout plan.

nina: Assigning components: @cheng for auth singleflight, @raf for governor scope change + tests, @tess for paginator prefetch + telemetry. I'll own the repro harness and canary plan. Planning to open draft PR today (branch: feat/devex/route-shim-governor).

raf: Quick thought: when changing scope defaults, include compatibility shim so older apps don't break. Maybe opt-in route-scoped via config until we validate metrics in canary.

cheng: Agreed. We'll gate route scope behind feature flag and watch auth.refresh.concurrent_count. Also add a dashboard for paginator.hold_ms heatmap.

tess: I'll add jitter and ensure prefetch has a bounded in-memory cache to avoid memory blowup. Config PREFETCH_WINDOW=2 pages max.

nina: Great. I'll post the PR link here once ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
